Description: Soft light spreads across the marsh as narrow channels of water wind between broad stretches of green. In Eastern Trail Marsh, the landscape is pared back to its quietest elements—water, grass, distant land, and a pale atmospheric sky. Painted in Scarborough, Maine, the piece follows the gentle movement of the marsh through layered greens and cool blues. The distant horizon remains soft and understated, allowing the winding water to carry the eye through the painting.
Story: Eastern Trail Marsh observes the open marsh landscape of Scarborough, Maine through simplified bands of water, grass, and distant land, with the emphasis on tidal channels and soft atmosphere rather than detailed representation.
